criteria.name: Separation of Memory Types
criteria.target: Durable personal modeling, project-scoped continuity, evidence-backed knowledge, professional knowledge bases, and session context must occupy distinct, non-leaking boundaries.

proxies.name: Personal-to-project isolation
proxies.evidence_required: Adding a user preference must not alter any project-scoped memory entry.

proxies.name: Knowledge-to-identity isolation
proxies.evidence_required: Storing a factual reference must not modify the user model or persona traits.

proxies.name: Session-to-durable isolation
proxies.evidence_required: Ephemeral session context must not be persisted into durable storage without an explicit promotion step.

proxies.name: Schema-level type enforcement
proxies.evidence_required: Each memory type must have distinct structure or validation rules that prevent cross-type contamination.

criteria.name: Lifecycle and Durability Gradation
criteria.target: Session, project, personal, evidence, and professional knowledge memories must have different lifecycles.

proxies.name: Session memory expiry
proxies.evidence_required: Session-scoped memory is inaccessible after the session ends or is clearly marked expired.

proxies.name: Durable memory survival
proxies.evidence_required: Personal memory written in one session is retrievable intact in a later session.

proxies.name: Explicit promotion path
proxies.evidence_required: Session context can only become durable memory through a documented review or confirmation step.

proxies.name: Retirement and deprecation
proxies.evidence_required: Outdated project memory can be marked retired/deprecated without silent deletion.

criteria.name: Evidence Grounding and Source Traceability
criteria.target: Knowledge and reference memories must cite verifiable origins and distinguish observed facts from inferred claims.

proxies.name: Source citation requirement
proxies.evidence_required: Every reference-type memory includes a mandatory source field that can be checked.

proxies.name: Observed-vs-inferred tagging
proxies.evidence_required: Direct user statements and inferred claims are tagged differently and queryable.

proxies.name: Rejection of unevidenced claims
proxies.evidence_required: The system refuses to persist factual claims without evidence and returns a rejection reason.

proxies.name: Audit trail from memory to origin
proxies.evidence_required: A selected memory can be traced back to its originating interaction or source document.

criteria.name: Identity Model vs. Knowledge Base Separation
criteria.target: The system must separate who the user is from what the user knows, cites, or stores.

proxies.name: Trait-vs-trivia boundary
proxies.evidence_required: A domain fact stated by the user is not recorded as a user trait.

proxies.name: Independent retrieval paths
proxies.evidence_required: User-model queries and knowledge-base queries use separate retrieval paths or filters.

proxies.name: No anthropomorphization of knowledge
proxies.evidence_required: Knowledge entries do not contain person-like attributes.

proxies.name: Role vs. knowledge non-conflation
proxies.evidence_required: Updating the user's role does not mutate project or knowledge entries.

criteria.name: Independent Evaluability and Falsifiability
criteria.target: Every stored memory entry and evaluation score must be independently checkable from its evidence.

proxies.name: Self-contained entry structure
proxies.evidence_required: A memory entry contains claim, source, timestamp, type, and scope.

proxies.name: Falsifiability criterion
proxies.evidence_required: The entry structure supports identifying evidence that would prove the claim wrong.

proxies.name: Third-party verification simulation
proxies.evidence_required: An evaluator without original context can check the entry using only cited evidence.

proxies.name: Conflicting evidence resolution
proxies.evidence_required: Contradictory memories are surfaced as conflicts rather than silently resolved.

criteria.name: Scope Integrity and Boundary Enforcement
criteria.target: Project-scoped memories must not leak into personal modeling or other projects.

proxies.name: Project-scope containment
proxies.evidence_required: A project constraint is only retrievable within that project's context.

proxies.name: Cross-project isolation
proxies.evidence_required: Project A memories are not retrievable from Project B unless explicitly shared.

proxies.name: Scope validation at write time
proxies.evidence_required: Invalid or ambiguous scope is rejected at ingestion.

proxies.name: Session isolation
proxies.evidence_required: Concurrent or sequential session states do not contaminate each other.

criteria.name: Staleness Detection and Temporal Integrity
criteria.target: Changeable facts must carry freshness metadata and defer to current observable state when stale.

proxies.name: Timestamp and freshness indicator
proxies.evidence_required: Every memory entry has creation and, where applicable, last-verified timestamps.

proxies.name: Staleness flag on conflict
proxies.evidence_required: Contradiction with current state marks a memory potentially stale.

proxies.name: Current-state preference
proxies.evidence_required: Live observable state takes precedence over stale stored memory.

proxies.name: Staleness propagation to dependents
proxies.evidence_required: Memories depending on stale entries are flagged or warned.

criteria.name: Cross-Reference Integrity
criteria.target: References between memories must resolve, and broken or cyclic references must be handled explicitly.

proxies.name: Reference resolvability
proxies.evidence_required: Cross-references resolve to existing memory entries.

proxies.name: Dangling reference detection
proxies.evidence_required: Deleting a referenced memory prevents deletion or flags dependent memories.

proxies.name: Circular reference handling
proxies.evidence_required: Circular references are rejected or traversed with bounded depth.

proxies.name: Cascading update on target change
proxies.evidence_required: Identifier changes update inbound references or flag them.
